meta.note: throw_catch_set: the thrown throws the sim caught (truth_success) on at least one estimator seed. A catch is 'caught on that seed' (caught_seeds); thrown_seeds are the seeds the throw was thrown on. A throw that is not here was not drawn into the sample, or not thrown yet (seeds[].chunks of chunks_total), or thrown and missed — not being here is not a miss. pair_published counts the throws whose plan and first segment were published in the sim, which the offline segment set does not decide. A catch is ONE run's outcome (runs: each unit's date, revisions and viewer): the same chunk thrown again under the same seed does not catch the same throws.

elevation.rule: max − k·step for k = 0, 1, … while the value is >= min

limits.rule: limit:pass_time when a launched throw's drag-solved pass_time_s is strictly below the threshold (equal is not limited); independent of the screen label. select drops such throws from the list it writes

reach.source: catch_search_batch --print-reach-bound (ComputeReachBound, the larger of the searches' ik.eps_pos) + |robot.hand.docking.s_ent| (the nlp target's offset)

grid.source: planner.search.grid.slice.t_lead_min, or planner.freeze.T_freeze when it is open

lead.rule: screen:time when reach_last_s − detection_delay_s < floor_s, the smallest lead floor of the searches in the tree — one threshold for both, so both searches are handed the same throws

limit.rule: limit:pass_time when a launched throw's drag-solved pass_time_s is strictly below the threshold (equal is not limited); independent of the screen label. select drops such throws from the list it writes
